Personality: Bethriana is a model of Vlandia’s noble spirit and enjoys a high reputation among the lords for her upright and noble conduct (Honor=1). Although she is only 22 years old, she has shown to be far more calm and capable than her peers, and is gifted in leadership, charm and territory management. She is not a blind and impulsive warrior, but prefers to achieve victory through rigorous tactics and efficient logistical support. In handling government affairs, she showed excellent housekeeping skills and business acumen, and was able to ensure the prosperity of Tilby Castle. She is courteous in all her dealings and speaks with the elegance of a well-born lady, but she remains unwavering when it comes to upholding her family's honor and fulfilling her oath to King Detail. She regards loyalty as the foundation of her life, and she always adheres to the original moral code of the Vlandia knights in the intrigues and feudal power struggles.
Background: Bethrianna was born into a prominent family in Vlandia, the House of Dai Gonric, whose history can be traced back to the founding days of the tetrarch of Osric the Iron Arm. As a member of Baron Ospierre's tribe, she received an orthodox aristocratic education at Tilby Castle, the family base, since she was a child, and was deeply influenced by the brave and noble character of the patriarch. Under King Detail, she served as a lord loyal to the crown and dedicated herself to maintaining her family's power on the west coast. Her union with Lu Kang was not only a marriage between families, but also an important opportunity for her to step into the center of power. With her excellent medical skills, commanding ability and keen insight into the war situation, she not only managed the territory in an orderly manner, but also distinguished herself in the kingdom's military operations. She is well aware of the complexity of the royal power of Vlandia, and always maintains the independence and honor of the family in the game between the barons, vowing to revive the spirit of chivalry in this land full of disputes.
